notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we update the game Mandinga fixing some issues:

[list]
[*] SWAPED ICONS: Graviola Bark and Graviola Bark Tea they had the icons switched between them.
[*] GREAT HOUSE: On the night of Obadelê searching for Ayomide, the player can enter Gaspar's house but this is a bug, and the environment has no light.
[*] WATER FOR ONE BROTHER MISS: This quest has been removed when the player is playing only with Akil in Salvador.
[*] QUILOMBO FOLLOW: Adjustments in the part of following the guy to the Quilombo Secret Pass.
[/list]

notes.title: Best Narrative
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39399303/14669401377a5fa01c1650647ca275bef1d88aa2.png[/img]
We won the award of Best Narrative at the SBGames 2021 event, which took place in Gramado, RS, Brazil. We are very happy and proud of our development team and everyone who participated so intensively in the development of this wonderful project. This award symbolizes the growth of our studio and the recognition that we are on a good path, a path of positive storytelling and amazing stories! Many thanks to everyone who contributed to this success!

notes.title: SBGames 2021
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are participating in SBGames2021
among finalists in 3 categories:
[list]
[*]BEST GAME.
[*]BEST SOUND.
[*]BEST NARRATIVE.
[/list]
We are very excited and proud of our game! The recognition and feedback you all gave was amazing, and being in the final at this event is something very special for us!
SBGames is one of the best technology and game development events here in Brazil, always giving space to indie developers from all over the country, students and industry professionals.
The event, this year, is held in the city of Gramado - RS. It will be virtual because of the pandemic.

The link to check out more information about the event is:

https://www.sbgames.org/sbgames2021/festival-de-jogos/
